jobs.title: Client Technology Strategist
jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 105424

The Client CTS is a senior executive responsible for shaping technology strategy across strategic client accounts and ensuring technology acts as a true business enabler. Acting as a trusted advisor to C-level leaders, the Client CTS translates complex business needs into actionable technology solutions, contributes to enterprise architecture roadmaps, and
strengthens Insight’s position as a strategic partner.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the definition of solution objectives across selected client accounts, aligning technology initiatives with business priorities.
• Make executive decisions on technology strategy, architecture, and solution delivery, balancing short-term client needs with long-term goals.
• Introduce relevant technological innovations to clients and contribute to industry thought leadership.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning and innovation within both Insight and client teams.
• Build strong, trust-based relationships with client leadership and key stakeholders.
• Provide expert guidance, domain insights, and ensure solutions deliver tangible business value.
• Serve as a Technical Executive Sponsor, securing the QA role and facilitating governance approvals.
• Ensure all solutions comply with regulatory requirements and mitigate operational risks.
• Mentor and coach technology teams, promoting knowledge sharing and professional growth.

Job Requirements:

• 10+ years in senior technology leadership roles (CTO, Enterprise Architect, Technology Director, Principal Consultant).
• Proven experience partnering with C-level executives to shape technology strategy.
• Strong background in enterprise architecture, digital transformation, and innovation-led solutions.
• Solid understanding of cloud architectures, infrastructure modernization, application transformation, and emerging technologies (AI, automation, cybersecurity).
• Experience in consulting or client-facing environments.
• Ability to translate complex business needs into actionable technology roadmaps.
• Executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
• Mentoring and coaching experience to develop technical teams.
• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (MBA is a plus).
• Preferred certifications: TOGAF, ITIL, cloud provider certifications (Azure/AWS/GCP)
Why join Insight

This is a chance to join a business that is actively accelerating its solutions and services motion. You’ll have the opportunity to build, influence and grow in a role with real impact, working with leading technologies, strategic partners and a highly collaborative team. At Insight, we are committed to gender-neutral pay equity. The established gross salary range for this position is 90.000€ to 107.000€ + bonus+ company car/car allowance (level quadro). The final offer will be determined based on objective criteria, including the candidate’s documented skills, qualifications, and professional experience evaluated during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Insight is a Fortune 500-ranked global provider of hardware, software, cloud, and services, helping clients design, implement, and manage technology solutions for today while enabling transformation for tomorrow.

Sales Operations is a critical enabler of Insight’s commercial performance. The function drives efficiency, scalability, and data-driven decision-making across the sales organisation by optimising processes, systems, and governance.

The Sales Operations Manager is responsible for maximising sales productivity and effectiveness within a defined business segment by owning forecasting, planning, performance management, and operational execution. This role partners closely with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and continuous process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

-
Forecasting & Pipeline Management

-
Own forecast cadence, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and transparency across pipeline, backlog, and bookings

-
Monitor pipeline health and conversion trends; proactively identify risks and opportunities

-
Performance Management & Analytics

-
Analyse sales performance metrics and deliver actionable insights to Sales Directors

-
Develop and maintain reporting packs, including QBRs, dashboards, and executive summaries

-
Support resource allocation and territory optimisation through data-driven recommendations

-
Planning & Governance

-
Support annual planning, quota setting, and target allocation

-
Drive account planning discipline and execution in partnership with sales leadership

-
Provide forward-looking insights for budgeting and operational planning cycles

-
Data & Systems Ownership

-
Ensure data integrity across CRM and ERP systems to enable accurate reporting and forecasting

-
Oversee system adoption, usage standards, and continuous process optimisation

-
Manage and resolve sales operations workflow issues and escalations

-
Process Optimisation

-
Identify inefficiencies across the sales lifecycle and implement scalable, standardised processes

-
Drive operational excellence initiatives across the region (e.g., EMEA alignment)

-
Establish and enforce best practices for deal management, renewals, and pipeline hygiene

-
Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

-
Partner with Sales Directors/Managers to drive execution against strategic priorities

-
Influence senior stakeholders through data-backed insights and recommendations

-
Lead and develop a high-performing sales operations capability

Qualifications & Experience

-
Strong experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or commercial strategy roles

-
Advanced proficiency in CRM/ERP systems and Microsoft Office (especially Excel)

-
Strong analytical capability with experience translating data into business impact

-
Proven ability to operate in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with high attention to detail

-
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership

About the role:

This position supports financial reporting, planning, analysis and forecasting for Insight's Global Business Services (GBS/IT), Global Marketing and Legal functions within Corporate FP&A, with global scope across North America, EMEA and APAC. This is a dynamic and high profile position requiring the successful candidate to utilize a broad range of financial, process, operational and strong communication skills, combined with strong business acumen. Reporting to the Manager, Business Planning & Analysis, this person will be a day-to-day finance contact for GBS, Marketing and Legal teams, providing guidance and input from finance on budgets, forecasts, headcount and ad hoc modeling and analysis.

Key Responsibilities:

- Provide financial reporting, analysis and planning support to Global Business Services (GBS/IT), Global Marketing and Legal leadership, serving as a day-to-day finance contact for budget, forecast and headcount questions.

- Prepare monthly and quarterly GBS (IT) financial results versus budget by leader and function, including the consolidated IT view (IT, Digital Transformation, business IT agreements and Warehouse), and support results reviews with GBS leadership.

- Support the annual GBS budget and forecast cycles in Adaptive Planning, including OPEX assumptions, service agreements, contract labor and professional services, depreciation, capital expenditures (CapEx) and variable compensation.

- Assist with financial tracking and monthly SteerCo reporting for enterprise IT programs (e.g., EBP), including budget versus forecast, contractor spend and capitalized labor, and support the annual EBP budget and royalty allocation.

- Support Global Marketing budget, forecast and headcount reporting, including the transition of Marketing cost centers to the global structure, and assist with financial review of sponsorships, events and partner agreements (payment terms, funding source and ROI).

- Prepare budget, forecast, headcount and expense reporting and analysis for the Legal function.

- Prepare semi-monthly Digital Commerce (eCommerce) revenue reporting for North America, EMEA and APAC by go-to-market, with quarter-to-date and year-to-date performance versus target.

- Maintain global headcount rosters and cost center alignment for supported functions across North America, EMEA and APAC, and reconcile to the Global HC report ahead of the annual workforce budget.

- Review open requisitions and hiring requests against budget and the FP&A requisition approval matrix, and flag compensation or headcount variances.

- Perform General Ledger and expense review, variance analysis and Power BI reporting, and support various ad-hoc analysis and special projects as assigned.

- Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in various Accounting & Finance functions.

- Minimum 2 years in a business analysis and requirements definition.

- Minimum 2 years’ experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling and analysis or Developing.

- Highly articulate in both oral and written communication, presentation, persuasion and negotiation to achieve desired result

- Can communicate effectively and credibly with all organizational levels, with the specific ability to gain trust, draw out needs, creatively propose ideas, and immediately and expertly resolve conflicts and concerns

- Ambitious, flexible, and aggressive. A self-starter who requires minimum supervision and adapts easily to changing work environments and requirements and can drive for results.

- General knowledge of information technology (networks, operating systems, business applications, web technology, databases)

- Ability to work flexible hours as needed

- Ability to adapt and work well in a rapidly changing environment and be a change leader

- Demonstrated ability to deliver while working under time pressure with multiple deadlines
